en.headline: Coleman Wong climbs to career-high ATP ranking of 92
en.dek: The Hong Kong player rose 16 places after earning 92 ranking points from his run to the Los Cabos semi-finals, becoming the first local man inside the top 100.
body: Hong Kong tennis player Coleman Wong has risen to a career-high ATP singles ranking of 92 after the latest official update released on Monday, the first time a male player from the city has entered the world’s top 100.

Wong earned 92 ranking points from his performance at the ATP 250 event in Los Cabos, Mexico, last week, where he reached the semi-finals for the first time on the main tour before losing to France’s Arthur Gea. His total points now stand at 680.

In a social-media post, Wong described cracking the top 100 as an achievement unlocked and urged others to pursue their dreams while enjoying the process. He thanked supporters for their encouragement.

zh.headline: 黃澤林ATP排名升至第92位創生涯新高
zh.dek: 港將上週洛斯卡沃斯四強之旅為他帶來92分，最新正式排名攀升16位至92，成為首位躋身男單前100的香港球員。
body: 香港網球一哥黃澤林最新ATP男單世界排名升至第92位，創下個人職業生涯新高，亦是首位躋身世界前100的香港男球員。
黃澤林上星期在墨西哥洛斯卡沃斯ATP 250賽事歷史性打入四強，雖於半決賽不敵法國球員吉亞，但仍累積92分排名積分，總分達680分，排名一週內攀升16位。
黃澤林在社交媒體形容打入頭100位是「成就解鎖」，呼籲大家不要忘記自己的夢想，搏盡並享受過程，同時多謝大家支持。
